Mission

L'EPFL renforce sa capacité à mener des recherches de pointe sur les échantillons biologiques humains, les collaborations cliniques, les données sensibles, l'intelligence artificielle et l'innovation biomédicale. Pour soutenir cette ambition, l'EPFL met en place un cadre institutionnel pour la gestion des échantillons biologiques humains et des données de recherche sensibles. Cette initiative fournira aux chercheurs une infrastructure et des services sûrs, conformes et évolutives qui soutiennent la recherche de pointe tout en répondant aux exigences réglementaires suisses, européennes et internationales en évolution.

L'EPFL cherche un coordinateur expérimenté et visionnaire pour établir et développer cette nouvelle capacité.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

Développement stratégique :

· Diriger la mise en œuvre de la stratégie institutionnelle de l'EPFL pour les échantillons biologiques humains et les données de recherche sensibles.

· Élaborer une feuille de route à long terme pour les infrastructures de recherche humaine à l'EPFL en coordination avec les équipes opérationnelles.

· Identifier les possibilités de partenariats nationaux et internationaux et de participation aux infrastructures de recherche.

Gouvernance, politiques et conformité :

· Établir et maintenir des cadres de gouvernance pour les échantillons biologiques humains et les données sensibles, y compris des politiques d'acquisition, d'accès, de partage, de réutilisation et d'intendance.

· Soutenir l'alignement institutionnel sur les exigences éthiques, juridiques et réglementaires (HRA suisse, RGPD, protection des données, normes de biobanque).

· Promouvoir l'harmonisation et les meilleures pratiques dans les laboratoires et les unités de recherche de l'EPFL.

Coordination interinstitutionnelle :

· Servir de point de coordination institutionnelle pour les questions de conformité impliquant la recherche humaine.

· Coordonner la participation de l'EPFL aux infrastructures nationales et internationales (réseaux de biobanques, environnements de données sécurisés, initiatives de médecine de précision).

· Surveiller la planification budgétaire de l'écosystème de l'infrastructure de recherche humaine.

· Représenter l'EPFL dans les organes de gouvernance, les groupes de travail et les partenariats stratégiques concernés.

Données sensibles et soutien à la recherche clinique :

· Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles pour mettre en oeuvre des processus robustes de traçabilité, de gouvernance des données et d'utilisation responsable des données.

Échantillons biologiques humains et biobanques :

· Assurer une supervision stratégique de l'établissement et de l'évolution des services biobanques de l'EPFL.

· Soutenir l'intégration des services de biobanques de l'EPFL avec l'École des sciences de la vie et les partenaires cliniques.

Systèmes de qualité :

· Définir les attentes en matière de gestion de la qualité et les cadres de certification appropriés.

· Établir des ICR institutionnels, des mécanismes de rapport et des processus d'évaluation.

Engagement de la communauté de la recherche :

· Fournir des conseils d'experts aux chercheurs qui élaborent des projets comportant des échantillons humains ou des données sensibles.

· Promouvoir des programmes de formation et de sensibilisation et favoriser une culture de la recherche responsable et conforme dans toute l'EPFL.

Profil

Essentiel:

• Doctorat ou diplôme équivalent en sciences de la vie, en sciences biomédicales, en génétique, en bioinformatique, en santé publique ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Expérience importante de la gestion des échantillons biologiques humains, des données sur les sujets humains et des recherches cliniques et des essais cliniques.

• Expérience démontrée en matière de leadership de l'infrastructure de recherche, de gouvernance des biobanques, de gouvernance des données ou de programmes biomédicaux à grande échelle.

• Une bonne compréhension des cadres éthiques, juridiques et réglementaires pertinents pour la recherche humaine en Suisse ainsi que des bonnes pratiques cliniques.

• Expérience de coordination entre plusieurs intervenants et unités organisationnelles.

• Expérience de la gouvernance des données et des environnements de données sécurisés

Au-delà du travail, nos campus accueillent une communauté dynamique et un environnement unique, enrichis par des initiatives favorisant l'égalité, l'inclusion, la diversité, le bien-être et la durabilité, ainsi qu'un programme engageant d'activités culturelles, sportives et communautaires tout au long de l'année.

jobs.description:
Mission

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral researcher (W/M) to join our Neuroengineering Laboratory at EPFL ( https://go.epfl.ch/ramdya/ ) to work on an ERC funded project aiming to reverse-engineer insect limb motor control for bioinspired robotics.

The main focus of this project is how neural circuits in the motor system of the fly, Drosophila melanogaster, orchestrate limb movements and autonomous behavior in complex environments. Specifically, we are looking for Postdoctoral scientists to perform microscopy-based neural recordings in behaving flies, computational analysis, and, if interested, neuromechanical simulations or robots driven by connectome-constrained artificial neural networks. Candidates from outside the field of neuroscience are encouraged to apply, but must be curious, persistent, and passionate to delve into the mysteries of the brain!

Main duties and responsibilities

• Working on a ERC funded project aiming to reverse-engineer insect limb motor control for bioinspired robotics. The precise research topic(s) will be discussed with the successful candidate depending on their background, expertise and affinities

• Analysis and publication of results

• Build a strong network in the field of research

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Postdoktoranden (M/W), der sich unserem Neuroengineering Laboratory an der EPFL (http://go.epfl.ch/ramdya/ ) anschließt, um an einem vom ERC finanzierten Projekt mit dem Ziel zu arbeiten, die motorische Steuerung von Insektengliedmaßen für bioinspirierte Robotik umzukehren.

Schwerpunkt dieses Projekts ist, wie neuronale Schaltkreise im motorischen System der Fliege, Drosophila melanogaster, Gliedmaßenbewegungen und autonomes Verhalten in komplexen Umgebungen orchestrieren. Insbesondere suchen wir nach Postdoktoranden, die mikroskopische neuronale Aufnahmen in Verhaltensfliegen, Computeranalysen und bei Interesse neuromechanische Simulationen oder Roboter durchführen, die mit Connectome-beschränkten künstlichen neuronalen Netzwerken fahren. Kandidaten von außerhalb der Neurowissenschaften werden ermutigt, sich zu bewerben, müssen aber neugierig, hartnäckig und leidenschaftlich sein, um in die Geheimnisse des Gehirns einzutauchen!

jobs.description:
About

The Chair of Entrepreneurship and Technology Commercialization and the Entrepreneurship Education Hub at EPFL invite applications for a full-time Postdoctoral position in Entrepreneurship. Duration is one year, with the possibility of extension for another year upon mutual agreement. Starting date is flexible, latest January 2027.

Research

You will join the Chair of Entrepreneurship and Technology Commercialization (ENTC), led by Prof. Marc Gruber, within EPFL's College of Management of Technology. You will have scope to develop your own research agenda and to collaborate with Prof. Gruber and the Chair's researchers on ongoing projects.

We welcome young scholars in entrepreneurship, strategy, and technology and innovation management, using quantitative, qualitative or experimental methods. The Chair's research appears in leading journals, including the Academy of Management Journal , Management Science , the Strategic Management Journal and the Academy of Management Review . Prof. Gruber served as Editor-in-Chief of the Academy of Management Journal from 2023 to 2025. The Chair has a collegial, collaborative environment, and supports postdoctoral researchers toward successful job placement in professorial and academic positions.

https://www.epfl.ch/labs/entc/

Education

You will work closely with Dr. Davide Bavato, head of EPFL’s recently established Entrepreneurship Education Hub.

The Hub is developing a structured curriculum of entrepreneurship classes for science and engineering students, helping them to acquire entrepreneurial skills and explore venture creation alongside their studies. You will have the opportunity to actively shape the Hub’s development through course delivery and the design and coordination of educational programs. The position includes teaching responsibility for two courses (one per semester), corresponding to approximately 40 lecture hours per semester.

https://www.epfl.ch/schools/cdm/ehub/

Profile

• A Ph.D., completed or close to completion, in entrepreneurship, technology and innovation management, strategy, or a related management field

• Evidence of rigorous and original research

• Ability to teach effectively in English to science and engineering students

• Experience as main instructor is welcome but not required

• Be motivated to contribute to a collaborative research group and to the development of entrepreneurship education at EPFL

We offer

• Competitive remuneration and benefits, based on EPFL salary scale

• Research support for conference travel and data collection

• A vibrant campus with an innovation park and a large spin-off portfolio, in a management research cluster that includes HEC Lausanne and IMD within a few kilometers.

How to apply

Thank you for applying through our platform and uploading the following documents:

• Cover letter including teaching and research interests
• CV
• Job-market paper or representative writing sample
• Contact details for three referees

Review of complete applications begins on October 1st, 2026, and will continue until the position is filled on a fixed-term contract, renewable.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni

La Cattedra di Imprenditorialità e Commercializzazione della Tecnologia e l'Imprenditorialship Education Hub di EPFL invitano le applicazioni per una posizione post-dottorale a tempo pieno in Imprenditoria. La durata è di un anno, con la possibilità di proroga per un altro anno su comune accordo. La data di partenza è flessibile, ultima gennaio 2027.

Ricerca

Ti unirai alla Cattedra di Imprenditoria e Commercializzazione Tecnologica (ENTC), guidata dal Prof. Marc Gruber, all'interno del College of Management of Technology dell'EPFL. Avrete la possibilità di sviluppare il vostro programma di ricerca e di collaborare con Prof. Gruber e i ricercatori della presidenza sui progetti in corso.

Accogliamo i giovani studiosi nell'imprenditorialità, nella strategia e nella gestione della tecnologia e dell'innovazione, utilizzando metodi quantitativi, qualitativi o sperimentali. La ricerca del presidente appare in riviste di primo piano, tra cui l'Accademia di Management Journal , Management Science , il Strategic Management Journal e l'Accademia di Management Review . Prof. Gruber servì come caporedattore dell'Accademia di Management Journal dal 2023 al 2025. La Cattedra ha un ambiente collegiale e collaborativo, e supporta i ricercatori post-dottorali verso un posizionamento di lavoro di successo in posizioni professorali e accademiche.

https://www.epfl.ch/labs/entc/

Istruzione

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il Dr. Davide Bavato, responsabile del Centro di Formazione Imprenditoriale di EPFL di recente costituzione.

L'Hub sta sviluppando un curriculum strutturato di classi di imprenditorialità per gli studenti di scienza e ingegneria, aiutandoli ad acquisire competenze imprenditoriali ed esplorare la creazione di impresa accanto ai loro studi. Avrete la possibilità di plasmare attivamente lo sviluppo del Hub attraverso la consegna dei corsi e la progettazione e il coordinamento dei programmi educativi. La posizione include la responsabilità didattica di due corsi (uno per semestre), corrispondenti a circa 40 ore di lezione per semestre.

https://www.epfl.ch/schools/cdm/ehub/

Profilo

descriptionByLocale.en:
About

The Chair of Entrepreneurship and Technology Commercialization and the Entrepreneurship Education Hub at EPFL invite applications for a full-time Postdoctoral position in Entrepreneurship. Duration is one year, with the possibility of extension for another year upon mutual agreement. Starting date is flexible, latest January 2027.

Research

You will join the Chair of Entrepreneurship and Technology Commercialization (ENTC), led by Prof. Marc Gruber, within EPFL's College of Management of Technology. You will have scope to develop your own research agenda and to collaborate with Prof. Gruber and the Chair's researchers on ongoing projects.

We welcome young scholars in entrepreneurship, strategy, and technology and innovation management, using quantitative, qualitative or experimental methods. The Chair's research appears in leading journals, including the Academy of Management Journal , Management Science , the Strategic Management Journal and the Academy of Management Review . Prof. Gruber served as Editor-in-Chief of the Academy of Management Journal from 2023 to 2025. The Chair has a collegial, collaborative environment, and supports postdoctoral researchers toward successful job placement in professorial and academic positions.

https://www.epfl.ch/labs/entc/

Education

You will work closely with Dr. Davide Bavato, head of EPFL’s recently established Entrepreneurship Education Hub.

The Hub is developing a structured curriculum of entrepreneurship classes for science and engineering students, helping them to acquire entrepreneurial skills and explore venture creation alongside their studies. You will have the opportunity to actively shape the Hub’s development through course delivery and the design and coordination of educational programs. The position includes teaching responsibility for two courses (one per semester), corresponding to approximately 40 lecture hours per semester.

https://www.epfl.ch/schools/cdm/ehub/

Profile

• A Ph.D., completed or close to completion, in entrepreneurship, technology and innovation management, strategy, or a related management field

• Evidence of rigorous and original research

• Ability to teach effectively in English to science and engineering students

• Experience as main instructor is welcome but not required

• Be motivated to contribute to a collaborative research group and to the development of entrepreneurship education at EPFL

We offer

• Competitive remuneration and benefits, based on EPFL salary scale

• Research support for conference travel and data collection

• A vibrant campus with an innovation park and a large spin-off portfolio, in a management research cluster that includes HEC Lausanne and IMD within a few kilometers.

How to apply

Thank you for applying through our platform and uploading the following documents:

• Cover letter including teaching and research interests
• CV
• Job-market paper or representative writing sample
• Contact details for three referees

Review of complete applications begins on October 1st, 2026, and will continue until the position is filled on a fixed-term contract, renewable.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über

Der Lehrstuhl für Entrepreneurship und Technologie-Commercialization und der Entrepreneurship Education Hub der EPFL laden zum Bewerbungsgespräch ein, eine Vollzeitstelle im Bereich Entrepreneurship zu übernehmen. Die Dauer beträgt ein Jahr, wobei die Möglichkeit besteht, nach gegenseitiger Vereinbarung ein weiteres Jahr zu verlängern.

Forschung

Sie werden an der EPFL-Hochschule für Technologiemanagement (Engineership and Technology Commercialization, ENTC) unter der Leitung von Prof. Marc Gruber teilnehmen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Ihre eigene Forschungsagenda zu entwickeln und mit Prof. Gruber und den Wissenschaftlern des Lehrstuhls an laufenden Projekten zusammenzuarbeiten.

Wir begrüßen junge Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler aus den Bereichen Unternehmertum, Strategie, Technologie und Innovationsmanagement mit quantitativen, qualitativen oder experimentellen Methoden. Die Forschung des Lehrstuhls findet in führenden Fachzeitschriften statt, darunter das Academy of Management Journal, Management Science, das Strategic Management Journal und die Academy of Management Review. Prof. Gruber war von 2023 bis 2025 Chefredakteur des Academy of Management Journal. Der Lehrstuhl verfügt über ein kollegiales, kollaboratives Umfeld und unterstützt Postdoktoranden bei der erfolgreichen Stellenvermittlung in Professoren- und akademischen Positionen.

Die Kommission hat die Kommission aufgefordert, die Ergebnisse der Untersuchung zu prüfen.

Bildung

Sie werden eng mit Dr. Davide Bavato, Leiter des kürzlich gegründeten Entrepreneurship Education Hubs der EPFL, zusammenarbeiten.

Der Hub entwickelt einen strukturierten Lehrplan für Entrepreneurship-Unterrichtskurse für Studierende aus Wissenschaft und Technik, der ihnen hilft, unternehmerische Fähigkeiten zu erwerben und die Gründung von Venture Creation neben dem Studium zu erforschen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, die Entwicklung des Hubs durch die Kursbereitstellung und die Gestaltung und Koordination von Bildungsprogrammen aktiv zu gestalten.

Die meisten Schulen sind in der Regel in der Lage, die Schulbildung zu verbessern.

Profil

- Eine Promotion, abgeschlossen oder kurz vor Abschluss, in Entrepreneurship, Technologie- und Innovationsmanagement, Strategie oder einem verwandten Managementfeld - Nachweis der strengen und ursprünglichen Forschung - Fähigkeit, effektiv in Englisch zu unterrichten, um Wissenschaft und Ingenieursstudenten - Erfahrung als Hauptinstruktor ist willkommen, aber nicht erforderlich - Lassen Sie sich motiviert, zu einer kollaborativen Forschungsgruppe und zur Entwicklung der unternehmerischen Ausbildung an der EPFL beitragen

Was wir anbieten

- Kompetitative Vergütung und Vorteile auf Basis der Gehaltsskala EPFL - Forschungsunterstützung für Konferenzreisen und Datenerhebung - Ein lebhafter Campus mit Innovationspark und einem großen Spin-off-Portfolio in einem Management-Forschungscluster, der HEC Lausanne und IMD innerhalb weniger Kilometer umfasst.

Wie kann man sich bewerben?

Vielen Dank für die Bewerbung über unsere Plattform und das Hochladen der folgenden Dokumente:

- Briefumschlag einschließlich Lehr- und Forschungsinteressen - Lebenslauf - Stellenmarktpapier oder repräsentative Schreibprobe - Kontaktdaten für drei Referenzen

Die Überprüfung der vollständigen Bewerbungen beginnt am 1. Oktober 2026 und wird fortgesetzt, bis die Stelle auf einen befristeten Vertrag, erneuerbar gefüllt wird.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos

La chaire d'entrepreneuriat et de commercialisation des technologies et le centre d'éducation à l'entrepreneuriat de l'EPFL invitent les candidats à un poste postdoctoral à temps plein dans l'entrepreneuriat. La durée est d'un an, avec possibilité de prolongation d'un an sur accord mutuel. La date de début est flexible, dernier janvier 2027.

Recherche

Vous rejoindrez la Chaire d'entrepreneuriat et de commercialisation de la technologie (ENTC), dirigée par Prof. Marc Gruber, au sein du Collège de gestion de la technologie de l'EPFL. Vous aurez la possibilité d'élaborer votre propre programme de recherche et de collaborer avec Prof. Gruber et les chercheurs de la Chaire sur les projets en cours.

Nous accueillons de jeunes chercheurs en entrepreneuriat, stratégie, technologie et gestion de l'innovation, en utilisant des méthodes quantitatives, qualitatives ou expérimentales. Les recherches de la Chaire sont publiées dans des revues de premier plan, dont le Journal de l'Académie de gestion, les Sciences de gestion, le Journal de gestion stratégique et l'Académie de gestion. Professeur Gruber a été rédacteur en chef du Journal de l'Académie de gestion de 2023 à 2025. La chaire a un milieu collégial et collaboratif et appuie les chercheurs postdoctoraux en vue d'un placement réussi dans des postes de professeur et d'universitaire.

https://www.epfl.ch/labs/entc/

Éducation

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le Dr Davide Bavato, directeur de l'EPFL récemment créée.

Le Hub élabore un programme structuré de cours d'entrepreneuriat pour les étudiants en sciences et en génie, les aidant à acquérir des compétences entrepreneuriales et à explorer la création d'entreprises parallèlement à leurs études. Vous aurez l'occasion de façonner activement le développement du Hub par la prestation de cours et la conception et la coordination des programmes éducatifs. Le poste comprend la responsabilité de l'enseignement de deux cours (un par semestre), correspondant à environ 40 heures de cours par semestre.

https://www.epfl.ch/schools/cdm/ehub/

Profil

• Un doctorat, terminé ou presque terminé, en gestion de l'entrepreneuriat, de la technologie et de l'innovation, de la stratégie ou d'un domaine de gestion connexe

• Preuve d'une recherche rigoureuse et originale

• Capacité d'enseigner efficacement l'anglais aux étudiants en sciences et en génie

• L'expérience en tant qu'instructeur principal est la bienvenue mais pas requise

• Être motivé à contribuer à un groupe de recherche collaboratif et au développement de l'éducation à l'entrepreneuriat à l'EPFL

Nous offrons

• Rémunération et avantages concurrentiels, selon le barème des traitements de l'EPFL

• Appui à la recherche pour les voyages de conférence et la collecte de données

• Un campus dynamique avec un parc d'innovation et un large portefeuille de retombées, dans une grappe de recherche en gestion qui comprend HEC Lausanne et IMD en quelques kilomètres.

Comment présenter une demande

Merci d'avoir postulé à travers notre plateforme et téléchargé les documents suivants:

• Lettre de présentation incluant les intérêts de l'enseignement et de la recherche
• CV
• Papier du marché du travail ou échantillon représentatif d'écriture
• Coordonnées de trois arbitres

L'examen des demandes complètes commence le 1er octobre 2026 et se poursuivra jusqu'à ce que le poste soit pourvu dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée renouvelable.

• machine learning. The project focuses on the discovery of governing equations and constitutive
• relations for key multiphysics phenomena on the basis of rich micromechanical and
• experimental data. It pushes the boundaries of modeling and understanding crucial processes
• in geomaterials across scales, with application to geophysics, energy and sustainability.

• The successful candidate will contribute to a next-generation data-driven framework for
• scientific discovery in geomaterials. Research will involve the development of techniques

• neurosymbolic AI. They will also have the opportunity to lead international collaborations with

jobs.description:
Mission

Despite recent technological advances both in the data management and in computer architecture domains, our ability to analyze data still falls behind the unstoppable data collection rates. Data-intensive applications are increasingly more demanding in sophisticated algorithms to store, manage, and interpret data. To meet the challenges, database software needs to communicate efficiently both with the application layer and with the underlying hardware platforms, and deliver seamless computational and data management support. Research in the DIAS lab addresses both aspects of the challenge: we adapt data management technology to computer architecture trends by designing data manipulation techniques that exploit optimally the underlying hardware and I/O devices, and we enable new discoveries in scientific domains through automating physical database design and revolutionizing exploration algorithms in very large data repositories. The DIAS lab pioneers just-in-time query engines which support analytics on raw data, data cleaning and query optimization for heterogeneous distributed data, and hardware/software codesigned engines for demanding applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Work closely with all members of the lab carrying out excellent research

•
Supervise students and collaborate with other postdocs

•
(optional) Contribute to teaching (especially if interested in an academic career)

Profile

•
Highly motivated with proven scientific excellence in the areas of vector query processing, serverless/just-in-time query execution, parallel and distributed data management, and data management systems on emerging hardware

•
Passionate about inventing, building, and publishing quality database systems research

•
A strong publication record and hands-on experience in system development are especially important

We offer

• The DIAS Lab team is renowned for its collaborative and nourishing culture, which supports the lab’s members since their first day in the team and long after their departure

•
Excellent working conditions

•
The contract is fixed for one year initially, renewable up to four years

Informations

Interested parties should send an application through the system including a CV, a research statement, and the names of at least three references. For inquiries regarding the research aspects of the position, contact Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Duration: 1-year fixed-term contract, renewable

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Nonostante i recenti progressi tecnologici sia nella gestione dei dati che nei domini dell'architettura informatica, la nostra capacità di analizzare i dati ricade ancora dietro i tassi di raccolta dei dati inarrestabili. Le applicazioni ad alta intensità di dati sono sempre più esigenti in algoritmi sofisticati per memorizzare, gestire e interpretare i dati. Per rispondere alle sfide, il software del database deve comunicare in modo efficiente sia con lo strato dell'applicazione che con le piattaforme hardware sottostanti, e fornire un supporto di calcolo e gestione dei dati senza soluzione di continuità. La ricerca nel laboratorio DIAS affronta entrambi gli aspetti della sfida: adattamo la tecnologia di gestione dei dati alle tendenze dell'architettura informatica progettando tecniche di manipolazione dei dati che sfruttano in modo ottimale l'hardware sottostante e i dispositivi I/O, e consentiamo nuove scoperte nei domini scientifici attraverso l'automazione della progettazione del database fisico e la rivoluzione degli algoritmi di esplorazione in repository di dati molto grandi. Il laboratorio DIAS pionieri dei motori di query just-in-time che supportano l'analisi dei dati grezzi, la pulizia dei dati e l'ottimizzazione delle query per i dati distribuiti eterogenei e i motori codesignati hardware/software per applicazioni complesse.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

•
Lavorare a stretto contatto con tutti i membri del laboratorio che effettuano una ricerca eccellente

•
Superviare gli studenti e collaborare con altri postdoc

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission

Despite recent technological advances both in the data management and in computer architecture domains, our ability to analyze data still falls behind the unstoppable data collection rates. Data-intensive applications are increasingly more demanding in sophisticated algorithms to store, manage, and interpret data. To meet the challenges, database software needs to communicate efficiently both with the application layer and with the underlying hardware platforms, and deliver seamless computational and data management support. Research in the DIAS lab addresses both aspects of the challenge: we adapt data management technology to computer architecture trends by designing data manipulation techniques that exploit optimally the underlying hardware and I/O devices, and we enable new discoveries in scientific domains through automating physical database design and revolutionizing exploration algorithms in very large data repositories. The DIAS lab pioneers just-in-time query engines which support analytics on raw data, data cleaning and query optimization for heterogeneous distributed data, and hardware/software codesigned engines for demanding applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Work closely with all members of the lab carrying out excellent research

•
Supervise students and collaborate with other postdocs

•
Passionate about inventing, building, and publishing quality database systems research

•
A strong publication record and hands-on experience in system development are especially important

Excellent working conditions

Interested parties should send an application through the system including a CV, a research statement, and the names of at least three references. For inquiries regarding the research aspects of the position, contact Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

jobs.description:
Mission

The Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at the College of Management of Technology at EPFL invites applications for a full-time PhD student position within the EPFL doctoral school program in Management of Technology (EDMT).

We are offering a challenging full-time PhD student position at the Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at EPFL.

The mission of OES is to conduct world-class research and teaching at the intersection of operations, economics, and strategy, with a focus on organizations and their interactions.

At OES, you will have the opportunity to work on the design, analysis, and implementation of innovative models for decision-making, economics, and operations. Research topics may include optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, market design and pricing, operations research, dynamic systems, and strategy-relevant applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Develop and complete an original doctoral dissertation

• Conduct independent research in close interaction with the Chair and, where appropriate, with external or industry partners

• Contribute to teaching activities, including co-supervision of student projects

• Provide limited support for academic and administrative activities of the Chair

Profile

• An excellent Master’s-level degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

• A strong mathematical background, including familiarity with optimization, probability, and the analysis of mathematical models

• A sincere interest in business-related, economic, and operational problems

• Proficiency in English

• Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and team spirit

• Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset

We offer

• Excellent working conditions in an international research environment

• Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project

• Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions

• The opportunity to work on rigorous, practically relevant research at the interface of operations, economics, and strategy

Informations

Your application should include:

• CV

• Motivation letter

• Diplomas

• Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies

To be eligible for a PhD at EPFL, candidates must be admitted to an EPFL doctoral school program. For this position, candidates should also apply to the EPFL EDMT Doctoral School :
https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/

Application deadlines: January 15, 2027 and April 15, 2027. Applications to OES may be reviewed on a rolling basis; formal admission to EDMT requires a complete application by one of these deadlines.

Expected start date: September 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Mission

REON is an EPFL research-based venture developed at the Structural Xploration Lab, building the Reuse Viability Index (RVI), an AI system that predicts the reuse value of building components before demolition, using data from more than 23,200 reuse-market listings and transactions. We are looking for a developer with entrepreneurial ambition and the ability to grow into a founding role, to turn the existing research prototype into a working MVP fast enough to support the next grant application round.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Rebuild the RVI scoring engine as clean, standalone Python code, implementing the validated indicator formulas correctly

• Design and build the database layer (schema and storage) and connect it directly to the RVI engine

• Migrate the graph representation from Neo4j to a Python-native structure

• Implement data-ingestion and similarity-matching logic that completes missing component information (GNN)

• Build the web interface: data upload in, ranked results out

• Work independently from rough goals to working software, using modern tooling (including AI coding assistants) to move fast

• Keep the codebase clean and documented so it can be extended by others.

Profile

The role combines graph data, ML, and practical web development. Some technologies may be learned during the project, but solid Python skills and hands-on experience with graphs and GNNs are essential.

• Full-stack: able to own backend, data layer and frontend as one coherent system (upload data, run scoring, show ranked results).

• Degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or an equivalent field;

• Strong Python skills; experience with APIs, databases, data pipelines, testing and deployment.

• Has personally built and shipped at least one complete software product or system beyond coursework.

• Able to translate research or mathematical logic into reliable software.

• Uses AI coding tools effectively, but independently reviews, tests and takes full responsibility for the resulting code.

• Graph data, ML/GNN, and LLM experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to parse and work with structured building-data formats (BIM/IFC), or equivalent experience ingesting structured technical data from PDF/Excel sources

• Civil engineering or broader construction-industry background is an advantage, not required.

• Valid Swiss work permit is mandatory. Applications without one will not receive a response.

• Priority will be given to candidates already based in Canton Vaud or the Lausanne region, available to start immediately.

We offer

• The chance to build the technical core of an EPFL spin-out in formation, in circular construction and AI

• Direct collaboration with the founder and real ownership of what you build

jobs.description:
General

The Artificial Intelligence in Molecular Medicine (AIMM) Lab, led by Prof. Charlotte Bunne at EPFL, sits at the interface of computer science and the life sciences, affiliated with both the School of Computer and Communication Sciences and the School of Life Sciences, as well as the EPFL AI Center. As part of an industry collaboration with Novartis, the lab is opening a postdoctoral position on multimodal model development.

We are recruiting a postdoctoral researcher with strong expertise in large-scale AI development and a background in biology . Working in close collaboration with Novartis, the position focuses on the development of multimodal biological foundation models: from core architecture design and pretraining at scale to integration into agentic interfaces. The role comes with dedicated access to the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) and the Swiss AI Initiative.

Research directions include

• Multimodal model development: novel pretraining objectives, tokenization, and scalable architectures that integrate diverse biological data modalities.

• Multimodal representation learning: aligning and fusing information across modalities to capture biological systems at multiple scales.

• Agentic interfaces: integrating multimodal foundation models into reasoning and decision-support systems.

• Translational applications: bridging multimodal foundation model research towards impact in early drug discovery through public and Novartis-internal datasets.

We are looking for candidates with

• A PhD in machine learning, computer science, computational biology, or a closely related field (completed or near completion).

• Demonstrated experience in large-scale AI development, including pretraining, fine-tuning, or scaling on substantial compute.

• A solid biological background; familiarity with multiple biological data modalities is expected.

• A strong publication record at top-tier ML conferences and/or life science journals.

• Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for interdisciplinary research.

We offer

• Dedicated compute allocation on CSCS and the Swiss AI Initiative.

• Direct collaboration with the AI for Research team and core disease area teams at Novartis Biomedical Research.

• Mentorship toward an independent academic or industry research career.

• An international, collaborative environment at one of Europe's leading technical universities.

Information

Activity rate : 100%.
Contract : one year, with the plan of a one year renewal.
Location : Lausanne, Switzerland
Start date : ideally Fall 2026, with later start dates possible by arrangement.

To apply, please send a CV, a brief statement of research interests (1 page), and the names of two references. More information via aimm.epfl.ch . Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Nell'ambito di una collaborazione di settore con Novartis, il laboratorio sta aprendo una posizione post-dottorale sullo sviluppo di modelli multimodali.

Stiamo reclutando un ricercatore postdoctoral con una forte esperienza nello sviluppo AI su larga scala e uno sfondo in biologia . Lavorando in stretta collaborazione con Novartis, la posizione si concentra sullo sviluppo di modelli di fondazione biologica multimodale: dal design dell'architettura core e dalla preformazione in scala all'integrazione in interfacce agentiche. Il ruolo viene fornito con accesso dedicato al Centro Nazionale di Supercomputing svizzero (CSCS) e all'Iniziativa di AI svizzera.

• Sviluppo del modello multimodale: nuovi obiettivi di preformazione, tokenizzazione e architetture scalabili che integrano diverse modalità di dati biologici.

• Un solido background biologico; è prevista la familiarità con più modalità di dati biologici.

• Un forte record di pubblicazione in conferenze ML e/o riviste di scienze della vita.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione ed entusiasmo per la ricerca interdisciplinare.

Offriamo

• Distribuzione di calcolo dedicata su CSCS e l'Iniziativa di AI svizzera.

• Collaborazione diretta con il team AI per la Ricerca e i team di area malattia di base di Novartis Biomedical Research.

• Mentorship verso una carriera di ricerca accademica o industriale indipendente.

• Un ambiente internazionale e collaborativo in una delle principali università tecniche europee.

Contratto: un anno, con il piano di un anno di rinnovo.

Um sich zu bewerben, senden Sie bitte einen Lebenslauf, eine kurze Erklärung der Forschungsinteressen (1 Seite) und die Namen von zwei Referenzen. Mehr Informationen über aimm.epfl.ch . Die Anträge werden rollierend überprüft.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Généralités

Le laboratoire de l'intelligence artificielle en médecine moléculaire (AIMM), dirigé par le Prof. Charlotte Bunne à l'EPFL, est à l'interface de l'informatique et des sciences de la vie, affilié à la fois à l'École des sciences de l'informatique et de la communication et à l'École des sciences de la vie, ainsi qu'au Centre AI de l'EPFL. Dans le cadre d'une collaboration industrielle avec Novartis, le laboratoire ouvre une position postdoctorale sur le développement de modèles multimodal.

Nous recrutons un chercheur postdoctoral ayant une solide expertise dans le développement à grande échelle de l'IA et une formation en biologie. Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec Novartis, la position se concentre sur le développement de modèles de fondations biologiques multimodales : de la conception d'architecture centrale et de la préformation à l'échelle jusqu'à l'intégration dans des interfaces agentsiques. Ce rôle est accompagné d'un accès dédié au Centre National de SuperComputation (CSCS) et à l'Initiative Suisse d'AI.

Les orientations de recherche comprennent :

• Développement de modèles multimodal : nouveaux objectifs de préformation, tokenisation et architectures évolutives intégrant diverses modalités de données biologiques.

• Apprentissage de la représentation multimodale : aligner et fusionner l'information entre les modalités pour saisir les systèmes biologiques à plusieurs échelles.

• Interfaces Agentiques : intégration de modèles de fondation multimodales dans les systèmes de raisonnement et de soutien à la décision.

• Applications translationnelles : établir un lien entre la recherche sur les modèles de base multimodaux et l'impact de la découverte précoce de médicaments par le biais des ensembles de données publics et internes de Novartis.

Nous cherchons des candidats avec

• Un doctorat en apprentissage automatique, en informatique, en biologie informatique ou dans un domaine étroitement lié (achevé ou presque terminé).

• Expérience démontrée en matière de développement à grande échelle de l'IA, y compris préformation, réglage fin ou mise à l'échelle sur calcul substantiel.

• Un contexte biologique solide; la connaissance de multiples modalités de données biologiques est attendue.

• Un solide record de publication lors de conférences ML de haut niveau ou de revues en sciences de la vie.

• Excellentes compétences en communication et enthousiasme pour la recherche interdisciplinaire.

Nous offrons

• Allocation de calcul dédiée au CSCS et à l'Initiative suisse d'IA.

• Collaboration directe avec l'équipe de recherche sur l'IA et les équipes de base de la recherche biomédicale de Novartis.

• Mentorship vers une carrière de recherche universitaire ou industrielle indépendante.

• Un environnement international et collaboratif dans une des plus grandes universités techniques d'Europe.

Informations

Taux d'activité : 100%.
Contrat : un an, avec un plan de renouvellement d'un an.
Lieu : Lausanne, Suisse
Date de début : idéalement automne 2026, avec dates de début plus tard possible par arrangement.

Pour postuler, veuillez envoyer un CV, un bref énoncé des intérêts de recherche (1 page) et le nom de deux références. Plus d'informations via aimm.epfl.ch . Les demandes sont examinées en continu.

Mission

The Policy & Sustainability (PASU) lab at EPFL conducts applied and theoretical research on the economics and politics of sustainable development, as well as the policies to achieve it. More information at: https://www.epfl.ch/labs/pasu/ .

We are looking for a postdoctoral fellow to join our team to work on a new SNSF-funded project on Managing a Just Transition to Net Zero . This project aims (1) to measure economic/job vulnerabilities to the clean energy transition at the individual and regional level (drawing on labor market surveys and LLM), (2) to collect original survey data on individual-level policy preferences in response to the negative effects of decarbonization, and (3) to conduct quantitative impact assessments of ‘just transition’ policies implemented around the world.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Co-oversee the implementation of the project with the PI.

• Take the lead on work packages related to the candidate’s expertise.

• Mentor PhD students involved in the project.

Profile

• A PhD in quantitative social sciences (economics, public policy, political science, etc.) or in computational social science.

• An interest in problems related to climate, sustainability, energy, and/or labor economics.

• Ability and/or desire to work in a team/lab setting.

• Fluent in English (French not required)

We offer

• A stimulating research environment that encourages curiosity, innovation, and rigor.

• Opportunities to work on policy-relevant issues and connect with international organizations, the private sector, NGOs, and state authorities in the Europe, the US, India, and elsewhere.

• Space to conduct independent research.

• Excellent work conditions and benefits.

Informations

The application should include the following documents: a writing sample, a CV, and a very brief cover letter.

jobs.description:
Your mission

The energy transition is ongoing and the deployment of silicon-based photovoltaic capacity is growing fast. This position is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated postdoctoral researcher to join the ongoing activities around silicon photovoltaics in Neuchâtel.
The Photovoltaics and Thin Film Electronics Laboratory (PV-Lab) at EPFL is looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher in Photovoltaic Recycling and Circularity to strengthen its activities in sustainable photovoltaic technologies.
The successful candidate will work at the interface between scientific research, technology development, project management and industrial collaboration. The position will focus primarily on the development and scale-up of innovative recycling approaches for photovoltaic modules and their constituent materials, with particular attention to circularity, high-value material recovery and design for recycling.
In addition to conducting research, the candidate will play an active role in the management of collaborative national and European R&D projects, supervision of students and junior researchers, and coordination of activities with the PV-Lab's industrial and academic partners.
The position will be based at EPFL PV-Lab in Neuchâtel, within an international and multidisciplinary research environment with strong links to the photovoltaic industry.

Main duties and responsibilities

• You will develop and optimize PV recycling technologies, including mechanical, thermo-mechanical, delamination and advanced separation processes for conventional and emerging PV modules.

• You will investigate material recovery and circularity pathways for glass, polymers, encapsulants, backsheets, silicon cells, metals and composites, including their potential for reuse, remanufacturing and high-value recycling.

• You will develop material characterization and process-evaluation methods for end-of-life PV modules, assessing recovery yield, purity, energy consumption, environmental impact, scalability and economic relevance.

• You will plan and conduct experimental research, including experimental campaigns, data analysis and process optimization, while ensuring high standards of laboratory practice, documentation, scientific integrity and safety.

• You will supervise and mentor PhD, Master’s and junior researchers, supporting research planning, experimental work, interpretation of results, scientific discussions and knowledge sharing within PV-Lab.

• You will coordinate collaborative research projects, like Work-Package Leader in a European project, including scientific activities, partners, tasks, milestones, deliverables, resources, risks, meetings, reporting and technical communication.

• You will contribute to scientific dissemination and future research development through publications in high-impact scientific journals, international conferences, collaborative research proposals and funding applications.

Your profile

• A PhD in photovoltaics, materials science, polymer science, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, recycling technologies, environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline.

• A strong academic background in photovoltaic recycling, PV module materials, circular photovoltaics or end-of-life PV technologies.

• Alternatively, a strong background in polymer or composite recycling with a clear interest in applying this expertise to photovoltaics.

• Demonstrated experience in experimental research and laboratory work.

• Good understanding of materials, interfaces and manufacturing processes relevant to PV modules.

• Experience in material characterization and quantitative analysis of experimental data.

• Ability to independently define, plan and execute research activities.

• A strong scientific publication record appropriate to the candidate's career stage.

• Experience or demonstrated interest in supervising students and junior researchers.

• Strong organizational and project-management skills.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills and an ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

We offer

• A dynamic and stimulating work environment

• Access to state-of-the-art research facilities and laboratory resources

• Opportunity to collaborate with world-class scientists through a network of national and international stakeholders

• Opportunity to work at EPFL, an internationally renowned and top-ranking engineering university, which offers a dynamic, stimulating, interdisciplinary, international and friendly working environment, a broad range of scientific training and networking events and also hosts a vibrant entrepreneurial community

• Opportunity to combine research, scientific leadership, project management and industrial collaboration within a single role.

Informations

Activity Rate Min : 80.00

Activity Rate Max : 100.00

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year renouvelable

Reference: 2449

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua missione

La transizione energetica è in corso e la distribuzione della capacità fotovoltaica a base di silicio sta crescendo velocemente. Questa posizione è un'opportunità entusiasmante per un ricercatore postdoctoral di talento e motivato per unire le attività in corso intorno al fotovoltaico in silicio a Neuchâtel.
Il Laboratorio Fotovoltaico e Thin Film Electronics (PV-Lab) di EPFL è alla ricerca di un ricercatore Postdoctoral altamente motivato in Recycling Fotovoltaico e Circularity per rafforzare le sue attività nelle tecnologie fotovoltaiche sostenibili.
Il candidato di successo lavorerà all'interfaccia tra ricerca scientifica, sviluppo tecnologico, gestione del progetto e collaborazione industriale. La posizione si concentrerà principalmente sullo sviluppo e la messa a punto di approcci innovativi di riciclaggio per i moduli fotovoltaici e i loro materiali costituenti, con particolare attenzione alla circolarità, al recupero e alla progettazione di materiali ad alto valore per il riciclaggio.
Oltre a condurre la ricerca, il candidato svolgerà un ruolo attivo nella gestione di progetti R&D nazionali ed europei collaborativi, supervisione di studenti e ricercatori junior, e coordinamento delle attività con i partner industriali e accademici PV-Lab.
La posizione sarà basata su EPFL PV-Lab a Neuchâtel, all'interno di un ambiente di ricerca internazionale e multidisciplinare con forti legami con l'industria fotovoltaica.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

• Svilupperai e ottimizza le tecnologie di riciclaggio del fotovoltaico, tra cui processi meccanici, termomeccanici, di delaminazione e di separazione avanzata per moduli fotovoltaici convenzionali ed emergenti.

• Indagherete i percorsi di recupero del materiale e di circolarità per vetro, polimeri, incapsulanti, fogli posteriori, cellule di silicio, metalli e compositi, compreso il loro potenziale di riutilizzazione, riprodotta e riciclaggio ad alto valore.

• Svilupperai metodi di caratterizzazione dei materiali e di valutazione dei processi per moduli fotovoltaici end-of-life, valutando il rendimento di recupero, purezza, consumo energetico, impatto ambientale, scalabilità e rilevanza economica.

• Potrai pianificare e condurre ricerche sperimentali, tra cui campagne sperimentali, analisi dei dati e ottimizzazione dei processi, garantendo al contempo elevati standard di pratica di laboratorio, documentazione, integrità scientifica e sicurezza.

• Lei supervisionerà e mentore PhD, Master e ricercatori junior, sostenendo la pianificazione della ricerca, il lavoro sperimentale, l'interpretazione dei risultati, le discussioni scientifiche e la condivisione della conoscenza all'interno di PV-Lab.

• Coordinaterai progetti di ricerca collaborativi, come Work-Package Leader in un progetto europeo, tra cui attività scientifiche, partner, compiti, pietre miliari, realizzabili, risorse, rischi, incontri, reportistica e comunicazione tecnica.

• Contribuirai alla divulgazione scientifica e al futuro sviluppo della ricerca attraverso pubblicazioni in riviste scientifiche ad alto impatto, conferenze internazionali, proposte di ricerca collaborative e applicazioni di finanziamento.

Il tuo profilo

• Un PhD in fotovoltaico, scienza dei materiali, scienza dei polimeri, ingegneria chimica, ingegneria meccanica, tecnologie di riciclaggio, ingegneria ambientale, o una disciplina strettamente correlata.

• Un forte background accademico nel riciclo fotovoltaico, materiali del modulo fotovoltaico, fotovoltaici circolari o tecnologie fotovoltaiche end-of-life.

• In alternativa, un forte background in polimeri o riciclaggio composito con un chiaro interesse nell'applicare questa competenza al fotovoltaico.

• Esperienza dimostrata nella ricerca sperimentale e nel lavoro di laboratorio.

• Buona comprensione dei materiali, delle interfacce e dei processi di produzione relativi ai moduli fotovoltaici.

• Esperienza nella caratterizzazione materiale e analisi quantitativa dei dati sperimentali.

• Capacità di definire, pianificare ed eseguire autonomamente attività di ricerca.

• Un forte record di pubblicazione scientifica appropriato alla fase di carriera del candidato.

• Esperienza o interesse dimostrato nella supervisione di studenti e ricercatori junior.

• Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto.

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese.

• Forte comunicazione e capacità interpersonali e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente multidisciplinare e internazionale.

Offriamo

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e stimolante

• Accesso alle strutture di ricerca all'avanguardia e alle risorse di laboratorio

• Opportunità di collaborare con gli scienziati di livello mondiale attraverso una rete di stakeholder nazionali e internazionali

• Opportunità di lavorare presso EPFL, un'università di ingegneria di fama internazionale e di alto livello, che offre un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, stimolante, interdisciplinare, internazionale e amichevole, una vasta gamma di eventi di formazione scientifica e networking e ospita anche una vivace comunità imprenditoriale

• Opportunità di combinare ricerca, leadership scientifica, project management e collaborazione industriale in un unico ruolo.

Informazioni

Tasso di attività Min: 80.00

Durata: 1 anno rinnovibile

Deine Mission

Die Energiewende geht weiter und der Einsatz von Silizium-basierter Photovoltaik-Kapazität wächst rasant. Diese Position ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit für einen talentierten und motivierten Postdoktoranden, sich den laufenden Aktivitäten rund um die Silizium-Photovoltaik in Neuenburg anzuschließen.
Das Photovoltaik- und Dünnschichtelektroniklabor (PV-Lab) der EPFL sucht einen hochmotivierten Postdoktoranden für Photovoltaik-Recycling und Zirkularität, um seine Aktivitäten im Bereich nachhaltiger Photovoltaik-Technologien zu stärken.
Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird an der Schnittstelle zwischen wissenschaftlicher Forschung, Technologieentwicklung, Projektmanagement und industrieller Zusammenarbeit arbeiten. Die Position wird sich in erster Linie auf die Entwicklung und Skalierung innovativer Recyclingansätze für Photovoltaikmodule und ihre Bestandteile konzentrieren, mit besonderem Augenmerk auf Zirkularität, hochwertige Materialrückgewinnung und Recyclingdesign.
Neben der Durchführung der Forschung wird der Kandidat eine aktive Rolle bei der Verwaltung von gemeinsamen nationalen und europäischen F&E-Projekten, der Betreuung von Studenten und Nachwuchsforschern und der Koordination der Aktivitäten mit den industriellen und akademischen Partnern des PV-Lab spielen.
Die Position wird am EPFL PV-Lab in Neuenburg in einem internationalen und multidisziplinären Forschungsumfeld mit starken Verbindungen zur Photovoltaikindustrie angesiedelt sein.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

• Sie entwickeln und optimieren PV-Recycling-Technologien, einschließlich mechanischer, thermomechanischer, Delaminations- und fortschrittlicher Trennprozesse für konventionelle und aufkommende PV-Module.

• Sie werden Materialrückgewinnungs- und Kreislaufwege für Glas, Polymere, Verkapselungen, Backsheets, Siliziumzellen, Metalle und Verbundwerkstoffe untersuchen, einschließlich ihres Potenzials für Wiederverwendung, Wiederaufarbeitung und hochwertiges Recycling.

• Sie entwickeln Materialcharakterisierungs- und Prozessbewertungsmethoden für PV-Module am Ende der Lebensdauer und bewerten Rückgewinnungsertrag, Reinheit, Energieverbrauch, Umweltauswirkungen, Skalierbarkeit und wirtschaftliche Relevanz.

• Sie planen und führen experimentelle Forschung durch, einschließlich experimenteller Kampagnen, Datenanalyse und Prozessoptimierung, während Sie hohe Standards der Laborpraxis, Dokumentation, wissenschaftliche Integrität und Sicherheit gewährleisten.

• Sie betreuen und betreuen PhD, Master- und Nachwuchsforscher und unterstützen die Forschungsplanung, die experimentelle Arbeit, die Interpretation der Ergebnisse, wissenschaftliche Diskussionen und den Wissensaustausch im PV-Lab.

• Sie koordinieren Verbundforschungsprojekte wie Work-Package Leader in einem europäischen Projekt, einschließlich wissenschaftlicher Aktivitäten, Partner, Aufgaben, Meilensteine, Ergebnisse, Ressourcen, Risiken, Sitzungen, Berichterstattung und technische Kommunikation.

• Sie werden zur wissenschaftlichen Verbreitung und zukünftigen Forschungsentwicklung durch Veröffentlichungen in einflussreichen wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften, internationalen Konferenzen, kollaborativen Forschungsvorschlägen und Finanzierungsanträgen beitragen.

Dein Profil

• Ein PhD in Photovoltaik, Materialwissenschaft, Polymerwissenschaft, Chemietechnik, Maschinenbau, Recyclingtechnologien, Umwelttechnik oder einer eng verwandten Disziplin.

• Ein starker akademischer Hintergrund in Photovoltaik-Recycling, PV-Modulmaterialien, Kreislauf-Photovoltaik oder End-of-Life-PV-Technologien.

• Alternativ dazu ein starker Hintergrund im Polymer- oder Composite-Recycling mit einem klaren Interesse daran, dieses Know-how auf die Photovoltaik anzuwenden.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in experimenteller Forschung und Laborarbeit.

• Gutes Verständnis von Materialien, Schnittstellen und Herstellungsprozessen, die für PV-Module relevant sind.

• Erfahrung in der Materialcharakterisierung und quantitativen Analyse von experimentellen Daten.

• Fähigkeit, Forschungsaktivitäten unabhängig zu definieren, zu planen und durchzuführen.

• Eine starke wissenschaftliche Publikationsbilanz, die der Karrierephase des Kandidaten angemessen ist.

• Erfahrung oder gezeigtes Interesse an der Betreuung von Studenten und Nachwuchsforschern.

• Starke organisatorische und Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten.

• Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch.

• Starke Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem multidisziplinären und internationalen Umfeld effektiv zu arbeiten.

Wir bieten

• Ein dynamisches und anregendes Arbeitsumfeld

• Zugang zu modernsten Forschungseinrichtungen und Laborressourcen

• Gelegenheit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Weltklasse-Wissenschaftlern über ein Netzwerk nationaler und internationaler Interessengruppen

• Die Möglichkeit, an der EPFL zu arbeiten, einer international renommierten und hochrangigen Ingenieuruniversität, die ein dynamisches, anregendes, interdisziplinäres, internationales und freundliches Arbeitsumfeld, ein breites Spektrum an wissenschaftlichen Schulungen und Networking-Events bietet und auch eine lebendige unternehmerische Gemeinschaft beherbergt

• Möglichkeit, Forschung, wissenschaftliche Führung, Projektmanagement und industrielle Zusammenarbeit in einer einzigen Rolle zu kombinieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre mission

La transition énergétique est en cours et le déploiement de la capacité photovoltaïque à base de silicium augmente rapidement. Ce poste est une occasion passionnante pour un chercheur postdoctoral talentueux et motivé de se joindre aux activités en cours autour du silicium photovoltaïque à Neuchâtel.
Le Laboratoire Photovoltaique et Électronique du Film Fin (PV-Lab) de l'EPFL est à la recherche d'un chercheur postdoctoral hautement motivé en Recyclage et Circularité Photovoltaïque pour renforcer ses activités dans les technologies photovoltaïques durables.
Le candidat retenu travaillera à l'interface entre la recherche scientifique, le développement technologique, la gestion de projet et la collaboration industrielle. La position sera principalement axée sur l'élaboration et la mise à niveau d'approches novatrices de recyclage pour les modules photovoltaïques et leurs matériaux constitutifs, en accordant une attention particulière à la circulaire, à la récupération des matériaux de haute valeur et à la conception pour le recyclage.
En plus de mener des recherches, le candidat jouera un rôle actif dans la gestion de projets de R-D nationaux et européens collaboratifs, la supervision des étudiants et des chercheurs juniors et la coordination des activités avec les partenaires industriels et universitaires du PV-Lab.
Le poste sera basé à l'EPFL PV-Lab à Neuchâtel, dans un environnement de recherche international et multidisciplinaire avec des liens solides avec l'industrie photovoltaïque.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

• Vous développerez et optimiserez les technologies de recyclage PV, y compris les processus mécaniques, thermomécaniques, de délamination et de séparation avancée pour les modules PV conventionnels et émergents.

• Vous étudierez les voies de récupération des matériaux et de circulaire pour le verre, les polymères, les encapsulants, les fiches arrière, les cellules de silicium, les métaux et les composites, y compris leur potentiel de réutilisation, de remanualisation et de recyclage à haute valeur.

• Vous développerez des méthodes de caractérisation des matériaux et d'évaluation des processus pour les modules PV en fin de vie, en évaluant le rendement de récupération, la pureté, la consommation d'énergie, l'impact environnemental, l'évolutivité et la pertinence économique.

• Vous planifierez et effectuerez des recherches expérimentales, y compris des campagnes expérimentales, l'analyse des données et l'optimisation des processus, tout en assurant des normes élevées de pratique en laboratoire, de documentation, d'intégrité scientifique et de sécurité.

• Vous superviserez et encadrerez le doctorat, les maîtrises et les chercheurs subalternes, en appuyant la planification de la recherche, le travail expérimental, l'interprétation des résultats, les discussions scientifiques et le partage des connaissances au sein de PV-Lab.

• Vous coordonnerez des projets de recherche collaboratifs, comme Work-Package Leader dans un projet européen, incluant des activités scientifiques, des partenaires, des tâches, des jalons, des produits livrables, des ressources, des risques, des réunions, des rapports et des communications techniques.

• Vous contribuerez à la diffusion scientifique et au développement futur de la recherche par des publications dans des revues scientifiques à impact élevé, des conférences internationales, des propositions de recherche en collaboration et des demandes de financement.

Votre profil

• PhD en photovoltaïque, science des matériaux, science des polymères, génie chimique, génie mécanique, technologies de recyclage, génie environnemental ou une discipline étroitement liée.

• Une solide formation universitaire en recyclage photovoltaïque, matériaux de modules photovoltaïques, photovoltaïques circulaires ou technologies photovoltaïques en fin de vie.

• Alternativement, une solide expérience dans le recyclage des polymères ou des composites avec un intérêt évident pour l'application de cette expertise aux photovoltaïques.

• Expérience démontrée en recherche expérimentale et en laboratoire.

• Bonne compréhension des matériaux, interfaces et procédés de fabrication pertinents aux modules photovoltaïques.

• Expérience en caractérisation des matériaux et analyse quantitative des données expérimentales.

• Capacité de définir, planifier et exécuter des activités de recherche de façon indépendante.

• Une solide publication scientifique adaptée à l'étape de la carrière du candidat.

• Expérience ou intérêt démontré pour la supervision des étudiants et des chercheurs juniors.

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion de projets.

• Excellent écrit et parlé anglais.

• De solides compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international.

Nous offrons

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant

• Accès à des installations de recherche et à des ressources de laboratoire de pointe

• Possibilité de collaborer avec des scientifiques de calibre mondial par l'intermédiaire d'un réseau d'intervenants nationaux et internationaux

• Possibilité de travailler à l'EPFL, une université d'ingénierie de renommée internationale, offrant un environnement de travail dynamique, stimulant, interdisciplinaire, international et amical, un large éventail de formations scientifiques et de réseaux et accueillant une communauté entrepreneuriale dynamique

• Possibilité de combiner la recherche, le leadership scientifique, la gestion de projet et la collaboration industrielle en un seul rôle.

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a full-time (100%) PhD position at ENAC at EPFL, Lausanne, Switzerland, within the Plant Ecology Research Laboratory (PERL): https://www.epfl.ch/labs/perl/

The PhD project will investigate how forest canopy temperature and spectral properties reflect tree physiological responses to increasing atmospheric drought and soil water limitation. The overarching objective is to understand how forests regulate canopy temperature and water use under drought and to use thermal and spectral signals to map forest vulnerability from individual trees to large spatial scales.

The project will combine plant ecophysiology, field experiments, thermal and spectral remote sensing, UAV observations, and satellite data. Initial work will take place at the Pfynwald experimental forest in Switzerland, where ongoing manipulations allow disentangling the effects of vapor pressure deficit (VPD) and soil moisture on mature trees. The project will then expand to a network of forest sites across Europe and ultimately use satellite observations to assess forest sensitivity and vulnerability at continental to global scales.

The successful candidate will be supervised by Prof. Charlotte Grossiord (EPFL) and co-supervised by Dr. Petra D’Odorico (WSL) and Dr. Helena Vallicrosa (WSL).

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD student, you will be expected to:
• Conduct original doctoral research on forest responses to atmospheric and soil drought, combining ecophysiological and remote-sensing approaches.
• Conduct and analyze measurements including sap flow, dendrometer data, leaf water potential, gas exchange, chlorophyll fluorescence, and thermal responses.
• Analyze thermal, RGB and potentially multispectral or hyperspectral imagery collected from fixed cameras and UAVs.
• Use satellite and environmental datasets to identify regions where forests are particularly sensitive or vulnerable to atmospheric drought.
• Disseminate research findings through peer-reviewed scientific publications and conference presentations.
• Participate in laboratory activities and, when appropriate, contribute to the supervision of student projects.
• Contribute to teaching as part of the PERL group at EPFL

Profile

• A MSc degree in ecology, plant biology, environmental sciences, forestry, remote sensing, Earth observation, geography, or a related field
• Strong interest in plant and forest responses to drought, heat and climate change
• Interest in combining field ecophysiology with remote sensing and large-scale data analysis
• Experience with plant physiological measurements, field ecology and/or remote sensing is an asset
• Good quantitative and statistical skills
• Familiarity with R, Python, GIS, image analysis or remote-sensing software is an asset
• Self-motivated, independent and collaborative mindset, with a high level of rigor for academic research
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
• Willingness to participate in field campaigns in Switzerland and other European forest sites

We do not expect candidates to already be specialists in all components of the project. Candidates with a strong background in either plant ecophysiology or remote sensing and a clear motivation to develop expertise in the complementary field are particularly encouraged to apply.

We offer

• A stimulating, interdisciplinary and international research environment
• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions, with a 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 3 years (4 years in total) to complete the PhD
• Opportunity to conduct state-of-the-art research combining experimental plant ecophysiology, forest ecology and remote sensing
• Access to unique experimental forest infrastructure and long-term physiological datasets
• Collaboration with researchers at EPFL, WSL and a European network of forest research sites
• Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation and research visits
• A collaborative research environment within PERL, with expertise spanning plant ecophysiology, forest drought responses, climate extremes and ecosystem functioning

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. the Doctoral School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (EDCE). Please check this page for additional information on admission. Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. The application for the EDCE doctoral school can be conducted after the candidate selection.
Only applications submitted through the online platform will be considered. You are asked to supply:
• A cover letter outlining your motivation for the position, your relevant experience, and your interest in the project (PDF, up to 2 pages)
• A single PDF containing your Curriculum Vitae, and contact information for 2 referees

Application deadline: Running deadline. The position will remain open until filled.
Contract Start Date: April or May, 2027
Activity Rate: 100%
Contract Type: CDD
Duration: 1 year, renewable

Reference: For more information, please contact: Charlotte Grossiord (charlotte.grossiord@epfl.ch), Petra D’Odorico (WSL, petra.dodorico@wsl.ch), or Helena Vallicrosa (WSL, helena.vallicrosa@epfl.ch). Applications sent directly to these email addresses shall not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Stiamo offrendo una posizione di dottorato a tempo pieno (100%) presso l'ENAC presso l'EPFL, Losanna, Svizzera, all'interno del Laboratorio di ricerca per l'ecologia vegetale (PERL): https://www.epfl.ch/labs/perl/

Il progetto PhD studierà come la temperatura del baldacchino forestale e le proprietà spettrali riflettono le risposte fisiologiche dell'albero per aumentare la siccità atmosferica e la limitazione dell'acqua del suolo. L'obiettivo è quello di capire come le foreste regolano la temperatura del baldacchino e l'uso dell'acqua sotto la siccità e di utilizzare segnali termici e spettrali per mappare la vulnerabilità della foresta da singoli alberi a grandi scale spaziali.

Il progetto combina ecofisiologia vegetale, esperimenti sul campo, telerilevamento termico e spettrale, osservazioni UAV e dati satellitari. Il lavoro iniziale si svolgerà nella foresta sperimentale di Pfynwald in Svizzera, dove le manipolazioni in corso permettono di disinnescare gli effetti del deficit di pressione del vapore (VPD) e dell'umidità del suolo sugli alberi maturi. Il progetto si espanderà poi a una rete di siti forestali in tutta Europa e, infine, userà osservazioni satellitari per valutare la sensibilità forestale e la vulnerabilità a scala continentale a scala globale.

Il candidato di successo sarà supervisionato dal Prof. Charlotte Grossiord (EPFL) e co-superviso dal Dr. Petra D’Odorico (WSL) e dalla Dr. Helena Vallicrosa (WSL).

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Come studente di dottorato, ci si aspetta di:
• Condurre ricerche mediche originali sulle risposte forestali alla siccità atmosferica e del suolo, combinando approcci ecofisiologici e di telerilevamento.
• Condurre e analizzare le misure tra cui flusso di linfa, dati dendrometro, potenziale di acqua foglia, scambio di gas, fluorescenza clorofilla e risposte termiche.
• Analizzare immagini termiche, RGB e potenzialmente multispettrali o iperspectral raccolte da telecamere fisse e UAV.
• Utilizzare i dataset satellitari e ambientali per identificare le regioni in cui le foreste sono particolarmente sensibili o vulnerabili alla siccità atmosferica.
• Disseminare i risultati della ricerca attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche e presentazioni di conferenze peer-reviewed.
• Partecipare alle attività di laboratorio e, se del caso, contribuire alla supervisione dei progetti degli studenti.
• Contribuire all'insegnamento come parte del gruppo PERL all'EPFL

Profilo

• Laurea in ecologia, biologia vegetale, scienze ambientali, silvicoltura, telerilevamento, osservazione della Terra, geografia, o un campo correlato
• Forte interesse per le risposte vegetali e forestali alla siccità, al calore e al cambiamento climatico
• Interessi nella combinazione di ecofisiologia del campo con telerilevamento e analisi dei dati su larga scala
• Esperienza con misure fisiologiche vegetali, ecologia del campo e/o telerilevamento è un bene
• Buone competenze quantitative e statistiche
• La familiarità con R, Python, GIS, l'analisi delle immagini o il software di rilevamento remoto è un bene
• mentalità automotivata, indipendente e collaborativa, con un alto livello di rigore per la ricerca accademica
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, scritto e parlato
• Volontà di partecipare a campagne sul campo in Svizzera e in altri siti forestali europei

Non ci aspettiamo che i candidati siano già specialisti in tutti i componenti del progetto. I candidati con un forte background in ecofisiologia vegetale o telerilevamento e una chiara motivazione per sviluppare competenze nel campo complementare sono particolarmente incoraggiati ad applicare.

Offriamo

• Un ambiente di ricerca stimolante, interdisciplinare e internazionale
• stipendio competitivo e condizioni di lavoro eccellenti, con un contratto a tempo determinato di 1 anno (CDD), rinnovabile per 3 anni (4 anni in totale) per completare il dottorato
• Opportunità di condurre ricerche all'avanguardia combinando ecofisiologia vegetale sperimentale, ecologia forestale e telerilevamento
• Accesso a infrastrutture forestali sperimentali uniche e dataset fisiologici a lungo termine
• Collaborazione con i ricercatori di EPFL, WSL e una rete europea di siti di ricerca forestale
• Opportunità di collaborazione internazionale, partecipazione di conferenze e visite di ricerca
• Un ambiente di ricerca collaborativo all'interno di PERL, con competenze che spaziano dall'ecofisiologia vegetale, dalle risposte alla siccità forestale, dagli estremi climatici e dal funzionamento dell'ecosistema

Informazioni

Il processo di selezione coinvolge più fasi, e candidati a lista corta sarà richiesto di applicare a un programma specifico di dottorato EPFL per qualificarsi per un dottorato in EPFL, cioè la Scuola Dottorale di Ingegneria Civile e Ambientale (EDCE). Si prega di controllare questa pagina per ulteriori informazioni sull'ammissione. Si prega di notare che questo è un processo di applicazione separato necessario per essere idonei a completare il dottorato in EPFL. La domanda per la scuola di dottorato EDCE può essere effettuata dopo la selezione dei candidati.
Saranno prese in considerazione solo le domande presentate attraverso la piattaforma online. Ti viene chiesto di fornire:
• Una lettera di presentazione che illustra la motivazione per la posizione, la vostra esperienza e il vostro interesse per il progetto (PDF, fino a 2 pagine)
• Un unico PDF contenente il tuo Curriculum Vitae e informazioni di contatto per 2 arbitri

Termine per la richiesta: Termine ultimo per l'esecuzione. La posizione rimarrà aperta fino a riempita.
Data di inizio del contratto: aprile o maggio, 2027
Tasso di attività: 100%
Tipo di contratto: CDD
Durata: 1 anno, rinnovabile

Per ulteriori informazioni, si prega di contattare: Charlotte Grossiord (charlotte.grossiord@epfl.ch), Petra D’Odorico (WSL, petra.dorico@wsl.ch), o Helena Vallicrosa (WSL, helena.vallicrosa@epfl.ch). Le domande inviate direttamente a questi indirizzi e-mail non devono essere considerate.
